Sub:- Arrangements for smooth exercise of powers under sections
7A,7B, 7C/14B of the EPF & MP Act, 1952 - Administrative
scrutiny of the orders-— Instructions — Reg.

Ref:- This officer letter No. RRC-II/28(31)07/53677 to 53777 — dt.
17" October, 2007.

Sir,

Attention is invited to the above mentioned circular wherein revised
instruction in supersession of earlier directions was issued for handling the
cases initiated under section 7A, 7B, 7C and 14B of the Act for strict
compliance then onwards. The matter is being revisited on the basis of
feedback received and following clarification is issued:-

1. It has come to the notice of Head Office that the instructions issued
are being interpreted differently by officers in a manner which does
not appear to conform to the Head Office instructions. Taking a
serious view of the matter, it is once again advised to all the field
offices that directions contained in the Head Office circular have to be
followed meticulously without any deviation.

2. However, should any circumstance or situation arises where the
guidelines contained in this circular are difficult to implement due to
any practical or administrative reasons , RPFC -I in charge of the
Region shall forward a self contained proposal with proper
justification to Head Office for consideration. Till issue of further
instruction from the Head Office, the guidelines of the above circular
shall prevail.

3. Revised original jurisdiction under section 7A; Establishments
of SRO with more than 1000 members: In view of the practical
difficulties and logistic problems expressed by the field offices, now
the following arrangement for handling 7A cases is being issued in
partial modification to the earlier direction dated 17" October, 2007:-

The revised instructions are issued taking into cognizance the
increased number of defaulting establishments, the number of 7A/14B
cases initiated, timely initiation of statutory action for managing the
default position and utilizing the existing manpower. The implementation
of these guidelines expects to improve the compliance scenario by prompt
and expeditious action. The deviations at local level by field offices not
only dilutes the authority of Head Office but also leads to non uniformity
of procedure and non achievement of organizational goal in terms of
compliance and recovery and service to subscriber area. Timely action
under the statute is of utmost importance. Delay in initiation or
finalization of statutory actions adversely affects compliance management
making the dues unrealizable in the long run besides inviting criticism
from different forums as well as affecting the service delivery to members
who are the main focus of the organization. Therefore, instructions
issued from Head Office require strict compliance in letter and spirit by all
concerned.

All Addl. Central P.F. Commissioner, Zones are requested to review
the position and confirm that the revised arrangements are put in place
and ensure to forward the information as requested in the preceding
paras.

Please acknowledge receipt.
(This issues with the approval of CPFC) "
